tables.name: District Crime
tables.description: Rolled for each district: steps from the city's general crime. Modified by the district's condition level and entry. The district's own crime degree follows (District Crime Degree).

results.name: Far Worse
results.description: 2 steps worse than the city’s general crime level.

results.name: Worse
results.description: 1 step worse than the city’s general crime level.

results.name: Equal
results.description: Same as the city’s general crime level.

results.name: Better
results.description: 1 step better than the city’s general crime level.

results.name: Far Better
results.description: 2 steps better than the city’s general crime level.
